summary: Capricor Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting an FDA advisory committee vote on its BLA for Deramiocel. The committee voted 3-9 that evidence did not support effectiveness for cardiomyopathy in Duchenne muscular dystrophy. The vote is non-binding; FDA action date remains August 22, 2026. A press release was furnished. No corporate transaction, M&A, or other special-situation event is involved; it is a regulatory update, not a special situation.
